propositions: Bare substring containment in upstream-URL assertion accepts lookalike hosts (suffix-style: pandoc.org.evil.com; prefix-style: notpandoc.org) that do not actionably point to upstream.
GitHub code-scanning alert #88 flags the unanchored assertion as incomplete URL sanitization.
Replacing substring checks with a scheme+host-anchored regex using negative lookahead (?![\.\w-]) after the hostname prevents both lookalike classes while preserving real NOTICE matches.

The new regex pattern must reject https://pandoc.org.evil.com, https://notpandoc.org, and bare schemeless mentions while accepting valid upstream URLs (https://pandoc.org, http://www.pandoc.org, https://github.com/jgm/pandoc).
Test file touches only the assertion and its module-level compiled regex; version pins and NOTICE content remain unchanged.
